title: CoverageReport
description: Deterministic machine-readable result for the standalone coverage check.

authority.description: Contract implementation remains proposed, regardless of merge state.

contract.description: Owner contract identifier, not consumer repository identity.

contract_version.description: Exact supported input version, absent for unavailable/unsupported input.

coverage.description: Explicit claims, legacy uncertainty, or unavailable evidence.

diagnostic.description: One stable diagnostic, without untrusted provider data.

domains.description: Preserved claims only after the entire coverage check succeeds.

scope.description: Explicit scope: this supplements full source/schema/graph validation.

status.description: Validity of the declared coverage claims.

CollectionClaim.description: A preserved claim whose values are checked against the pinned owner schema.

collection.description: Collection state; independent of freshness and conformance.

freshness.description: Collector-supplied freshness, never refreshed by this check.

observed_at.description: Observation time, or explicit null when no observation was obtained.

reason.description: Fixed owner-defined reason code; no provider message is retained.

CoverageKnowledge.description: Whether a compatible projection provides any collection-completeness claims.

oneOf.description: Alpha.2 explicitly declares all domains, which may themselves be partial.
Alpha.1 says nothing about collection completeness.
Input cannot supply usable coverage evidence.

CoverageStatus.description: Semantic validity of collection claims only, never whole-projection conformance.

oneOf.description: Supported claims are consistent with represented root-domain records.
Malformed, unsupported or contradictory coverage input.
A protected input was withheld without identities or counts.
